site.title: The Lektor
site.tagline: The voice that started a $22B company.
site.heroLead: Poland dubbed Hollywood with one bored man reading every part. It was perfect. ElevenLabs' founders grew up on that voice — this site brings it back, rebuilt with their own technology.
site.galleryHint: Play a clip, then flip the switch — same moment, two worlds.
site.footerHomage: An homage to the Polish lektor · Built on ElevenLabs scribe_v2 + eleven_v3
site.footerNoClone: No lektors were cloned in the making of this site.

about.title: The voice every Pole grew up with
about.body1: In Poland, foreign films were never dubbed with a cast of actors. One man — the lektor — read every line, flat and unbothered, over the quieted original. Stallone, Streep, aliens, children: one voice. The style is called szeptanka — 'whispering'. To outsiders it sounds like a mistake. To Poles it sounds like home.
about.body2: Mati Staniszewski and Piotr Dąbkowski grew up on that voice, and founded ElevenLabs in part because of it — the idea that machines should speak every language, beautifully. In 2026 the company was valued at $22 billion, weeks after the Polish government invested in it.
about.body3: The Lektor closes the loop: the technology the lektor inspired, reproducing the lektor. Every clip is transcribed with scribe_v2, translated into flat Polish register by an LLM, read by a single Voice-Designed voice with eleven_v3, and mixed back over the ducked original with the authentic 600–900ms delay.
about.body4: No real lektor's voice was cloned. The voice is a design — an archetype, not a person. That line matters.
about.credits: Built by Radek · part of July of Voice

powiedz.title: Say it like a lektor
powiedz.hint: Type anything, in any language — the lektor reads it back exactly as written, in that language, with his professional indifference. No translation happens here: English in, English out (with a Polish shrug). Great for tweets, threats and wedding vows.
powiedz.placeholder: e.g. I'm going to make him an offer he can't refuse
powiedz.error: The lektor refuses. Try again in a moment.
powiedz.tooLong: Keep it under {max} characters — the lektor is a busy man.
